beat: Wednesday video-cut aftermath: lace-bra misunderstanding, fear and guilt

lines.original: She quickly jerked forward and maximized her own video....
lines.local: Dhika turant aage jhuki aur apna video maximize kar liya.

lines.original: Dhika: noticing something..... oh my godd....
lines.local: Dhika: Kuch notice karte hue—oh my god!

lines.original: the boys saw her eyes getting tensed....
lines.local: Dono ladkon ne dekha ki Dhika ki aankhon mein tension aa gayi.

lines.original: Then quickly she came back into straight position, minimized her video and went back to the twins video and gave Bantu a stern look.... all the while.. still not covering herself....
lines.local: Phir woh seedhi baith gayi, apna video minimize kiya aur twins ki video par lautkar Bantu ko sakht nazron se dekha; abhi bhi khud ko cover nahi kiya tha.

lines.original: Dhika: Bantu.... why did you asked me to wear this lace bra.... she asked sternly.... there was no smile on her lips....
lines.local: Dhika: Bantu, tumne mujhe yeh lace bra pehenne ko kyun kaha? Usne bina muskuraye sakhti se poochha.

lines.original: Bantu: uhhhh.. miss... I told you na... that my girl friends say that it feels good.... he answered honestly at what he has heard...
lines.local: Bantu: Uh, miss, maine bataya toh tha na—meri girlfriends bolti hain ki yeh achha feel hota hai. Usne jo suna tha wahi imaandari se kaha.

lines.original: Dhika: hmmmm....
lines.local: Dhika: Hmmm...

lines.original: Dhika: okay boys, we shall close the session for today and I will see you on Friday... see you...
lines.local: Dhika: Theek hai boys, aaj ka session yahin band karte hain. Friday ko milungi. Bye.

lines.original: She said the byes as quickly as she asked the question to Bantu and without even so much as a fake smile..... she disconnect the call...
lines.local: Bantu se sawaal poochhne jitni hi tezi se usne bye bola; nakli muskurahat bhi nahi di aur call disconnect kar di.

lines.original: With the video cut... both twins looked into each others eyes.... Not knowing what happened all of a sudden, they looked confused.... Bobby as usual didn't know what do to... but Bantu immediately stood up, grabbed his car keys and rushed outside.... Bobby knew where he was going.....
lines.local: Video band hote hi dono twins ek-doosre ko dekhkar hairaan reh gaye. Bobby ko samajh nahi aaya kya kare; Bantu turant utha, car keys li aur nikal gaya. Bobby samajh gaya woh kahan ja raha hai.

lines.original: Meanwhile at the house.... Dhika closed the computer and with a plain face... moved towards the mirror to get a better look... which she didn't do while dressing...
lines.local: Udhar Dhika ne computer band kiya aur bina kisi expression ke mirror ke paas gayi, taki dressing ke waqt jo nahi dekha tha woh ab theek se dekh sake.

lines.original: She noticed the central tip of the lace bra was stitched in such a way that it looked pointing sharp outwards and around it the cloth patch was dark rose in color, contrast to the lite rose color all through the bra.....
lines.local: Usne notice kiya ki lace bra ka beech wala tip bahar ki taraf nokeela sila hua hai aur uske ird-gird ka patch baaki halke rose kapde se gahre rose rang ka hai.

lines.original: It looked just like a nipple surrounded by an areola... and thats exactly what she thought she saw, when she looked in the video screen and she felt terrified at the thought of the boys thinking that it was her naked nipples which they saw.....
lines.local: Shape bilkul nipple aur uske chaaron taraf areola jaisa dikh raha tha. Video mein use bhi yahi laga tha, aur woh darr gayi ki boys ko shayad uske asli nange nipples dikhne ka bhram hua hoga.

lines.original: Even though it was not what it looked like....she felt very bad... she sat down on the bed and put her head inbetween her hands... many thoughts ran in her mind....
lines.local: Asal mein woh jo dikh raha tha waisa nahi tha, phir bhi woh bahut buri tarah upset ho gayi. Bed par baithkar haathon mein sir chhupa liya; dimaag mein bahut baatein chal rahi thi.

lines.original: Them seeing her in her bra.... and she seeing their bulges were all just an accident at first and then an exciting teasing game for her...she felt very comfortable with them and only because of that she did all those... but now, this situation made her feel guilty....
lines.local: Pehle unka use bra mein dekhna aur uska unke shorts ke ubhaar dekhna accidents the, jo baad mein uske liye exciting teasing game ban gaye. Unke saath comfort ke kaaran hi usne yeh sab kiya, lekin ab use guilt ho raha tha.

lines.original: Again Chotu was a different story.... he was such an innocent poor hearted kid.... she didn't feel any remorse with anything that happened between her and Chotu... Chotu was almost like a family to her... but with twins, it is different... they were her students...
lines.local: Chotu ka maamla uske liye alag tha—woh use bahut seedha aur parivaar jaisa lagta tha. Chotu ke saath jo hua us par use remorse mehsoos nahi ho raha tha, lekin twins uske students the, isliye yeh alag lag raha tha.

lines.original: The more she thought about it, the more she realized....she had no right feeling angry at Bantu...its not her character even.... He is just a sweet little fellow who liked her for who she is and how kind she is.... He merely suggested something out of likeness and she only did what she did, no one forced her into anything...
lines.local: Jitna usne socha, utna mehsoos hua ki Bantu par gussa karne ka haq nahi tha. Uske nazariye se Bantu ek pyara ladka tha jo uski kindness ko pasand karta tha; usne sirf suggestion diya tha, jo kiya woh Dhika ne khud chuna.

lines.original: It didn't clearly make sense to her as nothing wrong happened but still she felt terrible and disappointed at herself...
lines.local: Use theek se samajh nahi aa raha tha ki jab kuch galat hua hi nahi toh itna bura aur khud se disappointed kyun lag raha hai.

lines.original: She felt like crying.....
lines.local: Uska rone ka mann kar raha tha.

lines.original: About two hours passed and it was around 5 PM...she awoke to a sound... she had slept unknown to herself..... Waking up, she noticed a couple of missed calls from Bobby.....
lines.local: Lagbhag do ghante beet gaye; shaam ke kareeb 5 baje awaaz se uski neend khuli. Use pata bhi nahi chala tha ki woh so gayi thi. Uthkar dekha Bobby ke kuch missed calls hain.
